observed_semantics: Only independently verified outcomes influence learned value.
Observer cannot independently verify its own outcome.
Outcome verification is immutable once decided.
Verified attribution for one event cannot exceed 1.0 in total.
Objective-specific memories do not silently generalize to unrelated objectives.
Untested memories retain a neutral value prior rather than being suppressed.
Verified outcome value is recency-weighted with a configurable half-life.
Repeated events for the same memory are deduplicated.
